problem_statement: SIH26111 — Smart AI-Enabled Rapid Feed and Silage Quality Testing System

datasets.name: SilageGuard Synthetic Fermentation Benchmark
datasets.purpose: Edge ML pipeline prototyping, mobile JSON tree parsing verification, and UI integration testing
datasets.collection_method: Synthetic parametric generation based on Kung et al. (2018) silage fermentation guidelines
known_limitations: Temperature rise is generated algorithmically and does not represent physical thermo-couple recordings
Uniform class boundary sampling reduces realistic continuous overlap seen in degraded bunker pits

datasets.name: Silage Surface Texture Synthetic Prototype
datasets.purpose: Computer vision pipeline testing, Albumentations tuning, and mobile TFLite asset export
datasets.collection_method: Pillow procedural fiber lines and fungal hyphae colony noise generation
known_limitations: Procedurally drawn geometric noise does not capture true outdoor solar glare, moisture sheen, or unchopped stalk debris
Model trained solely on this dataset will fail under real field conditions without domain adaptation or genuine farm imagery

datasets.name: Silage Meta-Analysis & Fermentation Quality Reference
datasets.purpose: Ground truth baseline establishing agronomic safety thresholds for tropical and temperate forage silage
datasets.citation: Kung, L., Shaver, R. D., Grant, R. J., & Schmidt, R. J. (2018). Silage review: Interpretation of chemical, microbial, and organoleptic components of silages. Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 4020-4033.
known_limitations: Focuses on laboratory wet-chemistry and proximate analysis; does not contain physical real-time telemetry from handheld probes

datasets.name: Vidarbha Dairy Belt Silage Pilot Observations
datasets.purpose: Protocol and ground-truth schema for genuine on-farm pilot trials across Nagpur and Amravati dairy clusters
known_limitations: Pilot phase dataset intended for qualitative benchmark validation; full multi-season statistical sampling is ongoing
